jobs.title: Cybersecurity Intern
jobs.description: Cybersecurity Intern Company: Thinknovaa Location: Remote Duration: 3 Months Stipend: Up to ₹10,000 (Performance-Based) About the Role Thinknovaa is seeking motivated individuals to join its Cybersecurity Internship Program. This opportunity is designed for those interested in information security, ethical hacking, network security, threat detection, and protecting digital systems from potential vulnerabilities. Interns will gain practical experience through projects involving security assessments, vulnerability analysis, threat monitoring, and defensive security practices. Key Responsibilities Assist in identifying and analyzing security vulnerabilities in applications and networks. Perform basic vulnerability assessments and authorized security testing. Monitor and analyze security logs to identify potential threats. Explore Security Operations Center (SOC) workflows and incident response procedures. Assist in evaluating network security configurations and access controls. Work with cybersecurity tools for network analysis and vulnerability detection. Research emerging cyber threats, attack techniques, and security best practices. Document security findings and recommend appropriate mitigation measures. Collaborate on cybersecurity projects and maintain technical documentation. Skills & Qualifications Basic understanding of cybersecurity and information security principles. Familiarity with computer networks, TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, and networking concepts. Knowledge of Linux, Windows, or command-line environments. Understanding of ethical hacking, vulnerability assessment, or penetration testing concepts. Familiarity with Wireshark, Nmap, Burp Suite, or similar security tools is beneficial. Basic knowledge of firewalls, encryption, authentication, and access control. Understanding of SOC operations, SIEM tools, or incident response is an advantage. Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving abilities, and attention to detail. Good communication skills and willingness to learn. Who Can Apply? Applications are welcome from: College students and recent graduates Freshers seeking practical cybersecurity experience Working professionals looking to strengthen their security skills Career switchers interested in cybersecurity and information security Internship Details This is a three-month remote internship focused on practical learning and project-based experience. The stipend is performance-based of upto 10,000 and subject to evaluation.

jobs.description: Sphera is a leading global provider of enterprise software and services that enables companies to manage and optimize their environmental, health, safety and sustainability. Our mission is to create a safer, more sustainable and productive world. Sphera is a portfolio company of Blackstone, a U.S.-based alternative asset investment company that focuses on private equity, technology and innovation, and more. Blackstone businesses succeed through strong partnerships, a personalized approach and a commitment to exceptional performance with uncompromising integrity. Sphera and Blackstone are leaders in the Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) space. We are guided by our core values of Customer Centricity, Accountability, Bias to Action, Innovation, and Collaboration. It is important to us that each and every Spherion is not only eager to challenge themselves and knows how to get work done but is an awesome addition to our company culture. Supervisor, Information Security The Supervisor, Information Security is a people leader role responsible for day-to-day SOC operations protecting Sphera’s computer systems and networks, oversight of security tooling, and security project leadership. jobs.title: Security Engineer (AI & Privacy) – Ozyn.AI
jobs.description: Ozyn.AI is an AI assistant that works across people’s email, calendar, documents and messages, and takes actions on their behalf. People will only let an assistant into their lives if they trust it completely. Your job is to make Ozyn worth that trust. About the role You’ll be our first security hire, working directly with the CEO and the engineering team. You won’t be writing policies from the sidelines. You’ll review code, change the architecture, build the protections, and own security and privacy for Ozyn end to end. What you’ll do Secure the agent: design defences against prompt injection, unsafe tool use and data leakage, so that content in a user’s email or documents can never make Ozyn act against them. Protect connected accounts: own how OAuth tokens and permissions for Gmail, Google Calendar, Outlook and other integrations are requested, stored, scoped, rotated and revoked. Keep user data separate: guarantee one user’s data can never reach another user, across databases, caches, vector stores, logs and model prompts. Encrypt and minimise: set up encryption at rest and in transit, key management and secrets handling. Keep personal data out of places it doesn’t need to be. Build privacy into the product: data minimisation, retention and deletion, consent, and handling users’ requests to see or delete their data, in line with India’s DPDP Act and global norms. Review and test: threat-model new features, review pull requests, run security testing, and set up security checks in CI/CD. Detect and respond: set up logging, monitoring and alerting, an audit trail of every action the agent takes, and an incident response plan. Prepare for enterprise buyers: lead our path to SOC 2 or ISO 27001 and answer customer security questionnaires. Raise the bar: teach the engineering team secure defaults so security doesn’t depend on one person. What we’re looking for 4–8 years in application, cloud or product security, with real hands-on engineering. You can read and write production code. Experience securing a product that handles sensitive personal data, ideally as an early or sole security owner at a startup. Strong grasp of OAuth, identity and access management, cloud security (AWS or GCP), secrets and key management, and secure architecture. Practical understanding of how LLM applications fail: prompt injection, unsafe tool calling, data leakage through context and logs. Sound judgement: you know which risks matter now and which can wait, and you can explain trade-offs clearly to founders and engineers. Bonus Bug bounty findings, published security advisories, talks, write-ups or open-source security tools. Experience taking a company through SOC 2 or ISO 27001. Familiarity with India’s DPDP Act, GDPR or similar privacy rules. Why join Define security for an AI assistant from day one, as the person responsible for it. Work directly with the CEO in a small, fast-moving team. Grow into leading security as Ozyn scales.
